title: GavioRequest
description: The canonical, provider-agnostic request model. Field names are camelCase on the wire; Python binds them to snake_case (agent_id, parent_trace_id, ...).

traceId.description: UUID v7 (time-sortable). Assigned automatically if omitted.

parentTraceId.description: Links calls into a multi-agent DAG.

tools.description: Tool declarations the model may call (F-ADP-03). Optional; omitted means no tools. Each entry's `name`, `description`, and `inputSchema` are translated into the provider's native declaration; governance fields (permissions, risk, ...) are not sent to the provider.

toolChoice.description: How the model may use `tools` (F-ADP-03). Ignored when `tools` is empty. Null or omitted means the provider default (auto).

images.description: Binary image inputs (raw bytes), scanned for PII by the modality guard before any provider call (F-SEC-09). Not serialized onto the provider wire.

lineage.description: Prompt provenance (F-OBS-04): template, variable bindings, and RAG chunk sources. Copied into the AuditRecord.

promptLineage.description: Provenance for a rendered prompt. RAG chunk text is never stored — only source references.

ragChunk.description: A reference to a retrieved source — never the retrieved text.

content.description: Message text. For an assistant message that carries only toolCalls this is the empty string. For a tool message it is the tool output.

toolCalls.description: Assistant messages only (F-ADP-03): the tool calls the model made in this turn, in order. Python binds this key as tool_calls.

toolCallId.description: Tool messages only (F-ADP-03): the ToolCall.id this message answers. Python binds this key as tool_call_id.

name.description: Tool messages only (F-ADP-03): optional tool name, see ToolResult.name.

isError.description: Tool messages only (F-ADP-03): true when the tool failed, see ToolResult.isError. Python binds this key as is_error.

toolChoice.description: "auto" lets the model decide, "none" forbids tool calls, "required" forces some tool call, and {"name": ...} forces that specific tool.
